cases.title: AI Software Engineer
cases.text: Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential. As the fastest-growing, highest-performing charter school network in New York State, Success Academy is reimagining K-12 public education. Nationally recognized for our innovative, whole-child school model and outstanding academic results, Success Academy educators are empowering children from all backgrounds with the knowledge, skills, and self-belief to succeed in college and in life. We now need a results-driven AI Software Engineer/ Integration Specialist to join our AI Enablement team. Department The Technology Division at Success Academy is the chief provider of technology infrastructure, application services, security, and support. The Division partners with teams across the organization to equip students, teachers, leaders, and staff with the innovative technology tools and know-how necessary to achieve academic and operational excellence. We are looking for an AI Software Engineer to play a critical role in connecting AI tools with school systems. This role ensures that AI-powered solutions seamlessly integrate with existing School Information Systems (SIS), Learning Management Systems (LMS), and other educational technologies. The ideal candidate has a strong background in software integration, API development, automation, and cloud-based solutions. They should be comfortable working with education technology platforms while designing scalable, automated workflows to enhance school operations using AI. Requirements: 4+ years of experience in software integration, API development, or automation engineering. Strong proficiency in API development, automation workflows, and event-driven architectures. Knowledge of cloud-native integration tools in AWS, GCP, or Azure. Excellent problem-solving skills and an automation-first mindset. Strong ability to collaborate with AI, cloud, and data engineering teams to create scalable AI-driven solutions. Familiarity with LLMs and AI-powered automation is a plus. Responsibilities: Design and implement integrations between AI models and school systems (SIS, LMS, student data platforms, and assessment tools). Develop middleware, APIs, and automation scripts to enable AI-enhanced workflows for grading, student engagement analysis, and predictive insights. Build, deploy, and manage RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, and Webhooks to enable seamless communication between AI and school infrastructure. Automate data extraction, transformation, and synchronization between systems using ETL pipelines and API-driven workflows. Develop integrations with LLM-based AI assistants, chatbots, and recommendation engines to enhance learning experiences. Leverage low-code and no-code automation tools where applicable for rapid deployment of solutions. Ensure real-time data flow between AI tools and student management systems using Pub/Sub, Kafka, or event-driven architectures. Implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT) to protect student and faculty data. Ensure compliance with FERPA and other education data privacy regulations. Work with identity and access management (IAM) solutions to control AI system permissions. Work closely with AI teams, data engineers, and DevOps to deploy integrations in AWS and GCP. Develop serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, Azure Functions) for lightweight, scalable automation. Implement event-driven architectures using Step Functions, Pub/Sub, and Webhooks. Collaborate with educators and administrators to define integration requirements and automation opportunities. Technical Stack & Tools: Integration & API Development: RESTful APIs, GraphQL, gRPC OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, OpenID Connect Postman, Swagger (OpenAPI), API Gateway Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, EventBridge, S3, DynamoDB) GCP (Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery) Azure (Azure Functions, Event Grid, Cosmos DB) Automation & Data Pipelines: Python, Node.js, FastAPI, Flask, Express.js ETL tools (Talend, dbt) Messaging & Streaming: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Pub/Sub Security & Compliance: IAM & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Data encryption, secure API access Compliance with FERPA Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience. This position is not bonus eligible. cases.title: Analyst, Schooling Data & Insights
cases.text: Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential. About Success Academy Success Academy is the highest-performing charter network in New York — 59 schools, 22,000+ scholars, and eight straight years of 100% college acceptance. We’re growing to 100 schools and 50,000 scholars. Figuring out how to see our own academic performance clearly — and act on it fast — is one of the most important problems we have. The Role: Use AI to do everything. You build, analyze, prototype, and clean data with the full AI toolkit (Cursor and beyond). AI isn’t a side tool here — it’s how one person does the work of a whole team, and how we move at the speed leadership needs. Build the visualizations the network runs on. Interactive reports and dashboards that take a pile of scholar data and tell a clear story — exam results, school and teacher performance, readiness over time. The bar isn’t that a chart exists; it’s that someone looks at it and feels where the problem is. Design the methodology underneath. Take an ambiguous question — how do we fairly rank schools that give different mixes of exams? — and build a fair, defensible way to answer it. This is the reasoning core of the job. Get real data into shape. Pull the exports, point AI at the grunt work of cleaning and deduping, then QA every number against the source before it goes anywhere. Distill for executives. Turn the analysis into plain-English takeaways and a recommendation. If a smart 8th grader couldn’t follow it, it’s not done. Partner across the org. Work with the data and learning teams to get what you need, and present to senior leaders. What we’re looking for: We care about how you think, not where you’ve been. Specifically: Reasoning, first and foremost. You can take a vague, tangled question and turn it into a clean, structured analysis. This is the one thing we can’t teach. AI-native. You reach for AI tools by default and learn new ones fast. Clear communicator. You can explain a complex result simply, in writing and out loud, and hold your own in a room with leaders. Design instinct. A feel for simplicity and clarity — you know the difference between a busy chart and one that lands. High agency, low ego. You take a problem from question to answer end-to-end, and no task is beneath you. Quantitatively fluent. Comfortable in data; can teach yourself the tools and domain you don’t already know. This is a hybrid position based out of our NYC Financial District office. The schedule requires working on-site Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Monday and Friday. Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience. This position is not bonus eligible. cases.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
cases.text: Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential. We are seeking a highly organized, adaptable, and professional Executive Assistant to support our CEO and Founder, Eva Moskowitz. This is a unique opportunity to work alongside one of the country's most influential education leaders in a role that requires exceptional judgment, discretion, and responsiveness. Every day is different, and success depends on your ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and execute with precision in a fast-moving environment. This is an onsite position based in New York City, five days per week. The role will begin as a temporary 3-4 week assignment with the opportunity to convert to a permanent position if it proves to be a strong mutual fit. The Role As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will serve as a trusted partner responsible for keeping the CEO organized, informed, and operating at maximum effectiveness. You will manage a demanding schedule, coordinate shifting priorities, and ensure day-to-day executive operations run seamlessly. This is not a traditional 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. position. Your schedule will align with the CEO's needs, requiring flexibility for early mornings, evenings, and last-minute changes. The ideal candidate is energized by fast-paced work, thrives under pressure, and remains composed while managing sensitive and high-priority matters. Key Responsibilities Manage a complex and constantly evolving calendar, ensuring the CEO's time is prioritized effectively. Coordinate meetings, appointments, travel, and logistics while proactively anticipating scheduling conflicts. Serve as a trusted administrative partner, responding quickly to changing priorities and urgent requests. Exercise exceptional judgment, professionalism, and discretion when handling confidential information and communications. Ensure seamless execution of day-to-day executive operations, following through on critical tasks and action items. Maintain clear communication across internal and external stakeholders while representing the CEO with professionalism. Remain available to support the CEO's schedule, including work that extends beyond traditional business hours when necessary. Schedule & Availability This role is driven by the CEO's calendar rather than a fixed work schedule. Hours will vary based on business needs and may include early mornings, evenings, and occasional last-minute schedule changes. Lunch breaks are taken as workflow permits, and flexibility is essential to success in this role. This position begins as a temporary assignment anticipated to last approximately three to four weeks and does not constitute a permanent offer of employment. Candidates who demonstrate exceptional performance during the trial period may be considered for a permanent Executive Assistant opportunity. Who You Are Entry-level candidates with exceptional organizational skills and executive presence, as well as experienced Executive Assistants, are encouraged to apply. Highly organized with outstanding attention to detail and follow-through. Calm, resourceful, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Flexible and responsive, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances. An excellent communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills. Professional, discreet, and capable of handling highly confidential information. Able to work onsite in New York City five days per week. Passionate about supporting leaders who are driving meaningful impact. Why You'll Love This Role Work directly alongside the CEO of one of the nation's leading public charter school networks. Gain unparalleled exposure to executive leadership and strategic decision-making. Play a highly visible role with meaningful responsibility and impact. Join a collaborative, mission-driven organization dedicated to educational excellence. Opportunity to convert to a permanent position based on performance and mutual fit.
